pages.title: Alkahest
pages.text: The universal solvent the alchemists searched for, at last: it dissolves anything, and holds the whole of Chemistry in one fluid. Made in the Alkahest Still. One of the five fluids of Pleroma.
Made in $(item)Alkahest Still$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Alkahest.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Copper Ingot, Gold Ingot, Iron Ingot.
